sourceFile: 29. MSU-L20S15-07GMI - Report test 3 Type new bond SL-220LB, WE-4900, 5102S2 Ass'y frame+SP - Date 2025.07.17_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft misgroups the bond-type comparison and has ambiguous outcome condition extraction.
issues: Primary change should be normal bond PT8310M9S versus three new bond types, not date plus partial types.
SL-220LB is incorrectly treated as a subgroup instead of a test condition.
Tension rows lose Type/Sus context, making comparisons ambiguous.
Bond amount/dry oven result section is not represented as an outcome.
Evidence omits key rows listing the three tested bond types.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to bond type/material for Frame+Suspension assembly.
Model SL-220LB, WE-4900, and 5102S2 as changed conditions compared with Normal PT8310M9S.
Preserve date, line, suspension side, and sample context as subgroup keys only.
Re-extract NG rate and tension outcomes with full row labels and headers.
Add bond amount/dry oven outcome if comparable test rows exist.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient until rows listing all bond types, headers, and all comparable data rows are included.
